name: locale-notice
title: Locale Notice
description: Shows a value as you write it and as the reader's locale writes it, says what they would take it to mean ("In Germany, 1,000 reads as 1"), offers a form neither side can flip, and catches numbers typed with the other convention's decimal mark ("1,5" becoming 15).

meta.summary: Shows a number or date as the reader's locale would read it, so 1,000 isn't taken as 1 in Germany or 04/03 as the wrong day.
catches: Numbers whose separators flip meaning between locales
Dates like 04/03 read day-first vs month-first
Decimal comma or point typed for the wrong locale
Offers an unambiguous form (SI grouping, worded month)
limits: Uses the browser's Intl data, which varies by browser version
Only compares two locales at a time
Can't know the reader's locale unless you pass it
a11y: Notice and hints are polite live regions
Input has a visible label and is described by the hint
Keep button has an aria-label and title; icons are aria-hidden
